source.sha256_note: Recorded by earlier receipts; size and mtime re-checked before and after, bytes not rehashed.

rule.text: normal: both sides |H| < 90, V >= 0.9, >= 20 voting strides; reversed: both sides |H| > 90, V <= 0.1, >= 20 voting strides; else unresolved (also any within-recording heading switch). H = circular median stored pelvis rotation; V = fraction of strides whose marker tilt vote is the published sign.

thigh_recipe_R.note: expected a priori: the recipe uses the stored pelvis tilt

seeded_picks.rule: random.Random(seed): contrast = choice(sorted normal in-scope records); then one stride per side for each non-normal record (sorted) and the contrast, in that order.
